# `jwt_auth`

Validates JWT bearer tokens against a JWKS endpoint and injects verified claims as request headers.

## Configuration

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|-------|------|---------|-------------|
| `jwks_url` | string | yes | URL of the JWKS endpoint (JSON Web Key Set). The filter fetches public keys from here to verify JWT signatures. |
| `issuer` | string | no | Expected `iss` (issuer) claim. If set, tokens from other issuers are rejected. |
| `audience` | string | no | Expected `aud` (audience) claim. If set, tokens not intended for this audience are rejected. |
| `claim_headers` | object<string, string> | no | Maps JWT claim names to request header names. The filter extracts these claims from verified tokens and injects them as request headers for downstream filters. |
| `token_header` | string | no | Header to read the bearer token from. |

## Example

```yaml
filter: jwt_auth
jwks_url: "http://keycloak:8080/realms/ai-gateway/protocol/openid-connect/certs"
issuer: "http://keycloak:8080/realms/ai-gateway"
claim_headers:
  preferred_username: "x-tenant-username"
  groups: "x-tenant-group"
```
